items.title: Design a monitoring stack

assessments.notes: Replace conflation of Container insights and managed Prometheus. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Replace master/API-log shorthand with separately configured control-plane resource logs. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Separate Prometheus metrics from container-log collection. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Replace unspecified monitoring adequacy with assessable health-model and telemetry requirements. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Distinguish monitoring components without declaring one add-on sufficient. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.

Modernize the old combined Container insights metrics/logs description. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Remove categorical prohibition on exporting raw logs; documented monitoring supports governed external destinations. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Replace add-on-enabled compliance with documented configuration inventory and distinguish actual log delivery. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.

assessments.notes: Clarify test ownership and avoid treating unit tests as complete release confidence. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Remove unsupported functional-tool example and define test evidence instead. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.

items.title: Design automation to be reliable, secure, and maintainable

assessments.notes: Workload-wide requirement includes each clause of the checklist control; supporting guide reading limits remain explicit.

items.title: Clearly define your workload's safe deployment practices.

assessments.notes: Slot swap is not universal stateful rollback or guaranteed application correctness. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Clarify emergency change authorization and follow-up instead of treating all quick fixes as acceptable debt. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Make advanced Kubernetes rollout patterns conditional on health gates and recovery evidence. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
Qualify no-extra-charge claim and slot isolation/recovery assumptions. Narrow control or service scope; not all aspects of the upstream control.
